verses.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਕੈ ਰੀਝਾਈਐ ਗੁਨ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਕਵਨ ਮੋਹਨ ਜਗ ਮੋਹਨ ਬਿਮੋਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaun gun gai kai reejhaieeaai gun nidhaan kavan mohan jag mohan bimoheeaai ||

en.bdb: Singing what virtues of the treasure-house of merits can we please Him? With what pleasant actions can we enamor the bewitcher of the world?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨ ਸੁਖ ਦੈ ਕੈ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਣ ਗਹੌਂ ਭੂਖਨ ਕਵਨ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੋਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaun sukh dhai kai sukh saagar saran gahaua(n) bhookhan kavan chi(n)taaman man moheeaai ||

en.bdb: What comfort can be offered to the sea of comforts that would provide us His refuge? With what embellishments can we captivate the mind of the Lord who fulfils all desires?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਂਡ ਕੇ ਨਾਯਕ ਕੀ ਨਾਯਕਾ ਹੁਇ ਕੈਸੇ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਕਉਨ ਉਕਤਿ ਕੈ ਬੋਹੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: koT brahamaa(n)dd ke naayak kee naayakaa hui kaise a(n)tarajaamee kaun ukat kai boheeaai ||

en.bdb: How can one become the wife of the Lord-Master of millions of Universes? With what means and methods can the knower of inner things be apprised of the anguish of the mind?

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਹੈ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਜਾਂ ਕੈ ਬਸਿ ਕੈਸੇ ਬਸਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਂ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਲਗਿ ਸੋਹੀਐ ॥੬੦੨॥
verses.translit_en: tan man dhan hai sarabas bisavai jaa(n) kai bas kaise bas aavai jaa(n) kee sobhaa lag soheeaai ||602||

en.bdb: The Lord who has the mind, body, wealth and the world in His control, involvement in whose praise one becomes adorable; how can such a Lord be brought in one's favour?  (602)
